newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Liberia footballer gets death for drugs in Malaysia.
newsitem.headline: Liberia footballer gets death for drugs in Malaysia.

text.p: A Liberian football player was sentenced to death by a Malaysian court on Friday for trafficking heroin that was found in a pair of shoes, the national Bernama news agency reported.

Nobias Weah Ezike, 30, who played for Liberia's national team, was arrested with 237.3 grammes (8.37 oz) of heroin last March 9 in a hostel room of the Young Men's Christian Association (YMCA) in Kuala Lumpur.
Ezike said he was passing through Kuala Lumpur on his way home from Thailand, and denied the shoes and drugs found in the room belonged to him.

But High Court judge K.C. Vohrah said Ezike had failed to cast reasonable doubt on the prosecution's case, adding that the Liberian "was aware of the nature of the drugs concealed within the hollow of the sole of each shoe".
Ezike looked calm when the judgement was passed and his lawyer Bhagwan Singh said he would appeal the sentence.
